name: dumbbell squat (back on stability ball wall)
description: A dumbbell squat with a stability ball pinned between your back and a wall. The ball guides the movement and takes stress off your lower back.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step your feet forward, shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees and sink down as the ball rolls up your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
